comment: LQ-20261107-133 — the discovery lanes compare news sector names with symbol_profiles.sector,
and the two vocabularies name the same sector differently: GICS (what news entity extraction
emits) versus Yahoo (what symbol_profiles carries). Unmapped, a sector our universe covers
reads as a coverage gap forever: 'consumer_discretionary' and 'consumer_staples' were written
as MISSING_SECTOR candidates although symbol_profiles holds Consumer Cyclical 298 and Consumer
Each group is one SECTOR under different names. Names are compared after
dedupe.normalize_key (lowercase, punctuation to space, stopwords dropped), so write them the
way a reader would: 'consumer discretionary', not 'consumer_discretionary'.
Deliberately NOT here: sub-industries (retail, insurance, telecommunications, biotechnology,
pharmaceuticals, mining, ...). Those are narrower than the sector we hold and remain real
gaps worth surfacing — mapping them would suppress a signal, not fix a false positive.
A missing or unreadable file maps nothing (fail open to MORE gaps, never to fewer).
